title: Passenger Name Input
description: Prevents denied boarding and name-change fees by checking a flight or train passenger name against the ID, catching swapped names, a missing middle name, a title, suffix or nickname typed into the name, single-name passengers, accents the ticket can't print and names over the airline's limit, each with a one-tap fix, and reading it back as SURNAME/GIVEN TITLE the way it will print.
stops: Boarding denied over a ticket name
